title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1969-05-03
source: This is a matrix recording using two sources: SBD Reel shnid 124067: TASCAM 22-2 modified for flat transfer. Reel-> Tascam 22-2 -> Tascam MKII DR-07 (24-bit, 96kHz) - DC8Forensics for editing and modification and Audience shnid 000733: Reel>PCM>Dat>Tascam DA20>Audio Magic Presto>Prodif Plus>Soundforge>cdwav>shn

ai_review.summary: Good‑sound matrix recording captures a tight, compact set highlighted by a smoking Cryptical > Other One > Cryptical sequence and standout performances of “He Was a Friend of Mine” and “Doin’ That Rag”.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its concise flow and high energy, with a particularly tight cryptic reprise and Jerry Garcia’s soaring, fast‑picked solos on several numbers. Recording quality is described as good with no noticeable flaws, making the performance enjoyable to listen to from start to finish.

ai_rating.rationale: Four out of five reviewers gave 5‑star ratings and praised both the music and sound; only one non‑critical low rating appears, resulting in a strong overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers comment that the sound is good/clear with no reported dropouts or mix problems.

standout_songs: He Was a Friend of Mine
show_quality.setlist_flow: Compact, well‑sequenced set that moves smoothly through tight transitions, especially the cryptic reprise.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His playing is noted as picking up speed with beautiful, evolving guitar solos and memorable melodies.
